what: Lays a section as a color band with wavy top and bottom edges — the wave shape is four shapes whose crests shift half a cell each, cycled linearly over 15s on top and 16s on the bottom so the two edges surge endlessly off-beat. A character hidden behind the wave (optional) rises to 30% of its own height by 10% over 4s cubic-bezier(.36,0,.64,1) on the top edge and drops back at 90%, on the bottom edge it hangs upside down and bobs at 5s cubic-bezier(.86,0,.14,1).

options.edge: Wave height in px, default follows screen width: 100 · 70 (1560 and below) · 50 (1024 and below) · 25 (767 and below)
options.--fx-band: Band color (via the user’s css), default --kf-accent-soft — original yellow
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Band surface and wave svg version — if absent, the part inserts it at the front
options.[data-fx-part=rider]: Character hiding behind the wave (optional) — data-key selects top (default)·bottom, position (like top:-120px) and size are up to the user

note: The band is the using element itself, so the up-down wave overflows outward (into the sections above and below) by --fx-edge — leave that much margin in the neighboring sections. The character is on a layer behind the band, so only the part sticking out of the band is visible

from.where: index.html .ix-start · about.html .ab-enjoy (.h-wave — yellow band, top and bottom wave path d keyframes 15s·16s linear, navy character 4s · green character reversed 5s)
